title.en: Tailor your résumé to a role

body.zh: 先准备相关材料，打开助手后检查预填内容，再按发送开始。
body.en: Bring the relevant material, review the prefilled request in the assistant, then send it when ready.

prompt.zh: 对照这个岗位和我的真实经历，帮我改简历。
prompt.en: Help me tailor my résumé using the job description and my actual experience.

body.zh: 先准备相关材料，打开助手后检查预填内容，再按发送开始。
body.en: Bring the relevant material, review the prefilled request in the assistant, then send it when ready.

prompt.zh: 帮我模拟一次面试，一次问一题。
prompt.en: Run a practice interview with me, one question at a time.

body.zh: 带上备选方案、已有证据和个人约束，先检查预填的问题。
body.en: Bring your options, evidence and constraints, then review the prefilled question before starting.

question.zh: 我有几个 offer，想按个人目标和约束比较。
question.en: Help me compare my offers against my goals and constraints.
